defmodule C47GuardFixture.SourceTruthiness do
  def handle_call(_request, _from, state) do
    next = %{transport: state.transport, pending_ack?: false}

    if next.pending_ack? do
      throw({:noreply, %{next | transport: :unknown}})
    else
      {:noreply, next}
    end
  end
end

defmodule C47GuardFixture.NilTruthiness do
  def handle_call(_request, _from, state) do
    next = %{transport: state.transport, pending_ack?: nil}

    if next.pending_ack? do
      throw({:noreply, %{next | transport: :unknown}})
    else
      {:noreply, next}
    end
  end
end

-module(c47_guard_andalso_false_skips_rhs).
-export([handle_call/3]).

handle_call(_Request, _From, State) ->
    case State of
        S when is_atom(S) andalso map_get(missing_guard_value, S) ->
            throw({noreply, State#{transport := unsafe_transport}});
        _ ->
            {noreply, State}
    end.
guards.reason: Known map makes is_atom false; RHS and poisoned body must not be selected.

-module(c47_guard_required_rhs_boolean_results).
-export([handle_call/3]).

handle_call(and_case, _From, State) ->
    case State of
        S when is_map(S) andalso is_atom(S) ->
            throw({noreply, State#{transport := unsafe_transport}});
        _ ->
            {noreply, State}
    end;
handle_call(_Request, _From, State) ->
    case State of
        S when is_atom(S) orelse is_map(S) ->
            {noreply, State};
        _ ->
            throw({noreply, State#{transport := unsafe_transport}})
    end.
guards.reason: Unknown request visits both source clauses; AND true requires false RHS, OR false requires true RHS.

-module(c47_guard_unknown_lhs_orelse_true).
-export([handle_call/3]).

handle_call(X, _From, State) when X orelse true ->
    {noreply, State};
handle_call(_X, _From, State) ->
    throw({noreply, State#{transport := unsafe_transport}}).
guards.reason: X may be non-Boolean; default poison cannot be suppressed by the true RHS.

guards.reason: Guard failure from non-Boolean X is not false and must not become true under not.

defmodule C48BifFixture.ValidFunctionExported do
  def handle_call(_request, _from, state) do
    case :erlang.function_exported(:erlang, :is_atom, 1) do
      true -> {:noreply, state}
      false -> {:noreply, state}
      _ -> throw({:noreply, %{state | transport: :unknown}})
    end
  end
end

-module(c48_bif_finite_atoms_arity_boundaries).
-export([handle_call/3]).

handle_call(Request, _From, State) ->
    [Module | _] = maps:keys(#{erlang => ok, c48_unloaded_fixture_target => ok}),
    [Function | _] = maps:keys(#{self => ok, c48_missing_export => ok}),
    Arity = case Request of zero -> 0; _ -> 255 end,
    case erlang:function_exported(Module, Function, Arity) of
        true -> {noreply, State};
        false -> {noreply, State};
        _ -> throw({noreply, State#{transport := unsafe_transport}})
    end.
bifs.reason: Existing maps:keys abstraction supplies finite atom choices for both arguments; source branches exercise0 and255 without target lookup.

handle_call(Module, _From, State) ->

-module(c48_bif_outside_arity_subset).
-export([handle_call/3]).

handle_call(Request, _From, State) ->
    Arity = case Request of negative -> -1; above -> 256; _ -> 1000000 end,
    case erlang:function_exported(erlang, is_atom, Arity) of
        true -> {noreply, State};
        false -> {noreply, State};
        _ -> throw({noreply, State#{transport := unsafe_transport}})

bifs.reason: Observed native false for these integers is not widened into acceptance; out-of-subset semantics remain unknown, not badarg.
